citations.quote: INC-412 — sev1: payout webhooks stalled for 38 minutes
I was primary on-call. Diagnosed a connection-pool exhaustion caused by a slow downstream PSP call holding transactions open.
Mitigated by moving the PSP call outside the transaction boundary and shipping a pool-saturation alert.

rationale: The INC-412 ticket records a sev1 connection-pool exhaustion that stalled payouts for 38 minutes, and says you were primary on-call, diagnosed it and mitigated it, which matches the claim as written.
